start.speaker: narrator
start.text: The patient is barely conscious, breath rattling. Dr. Varga's tag on the bed reads CRITICAL — TRAUMA GEL REQUIRED.

choices.text: (Step back and speak to Dr. Varga.)

stable.speaker: narrator
stable.text: The patient is breathing easier now. Someone has written THANK YOU on the bed tag in shaky marker.

lost.speaker: narrator
lost.text: A sheet has been drawn up over the bed. Dr. Varga does not look at you.
